On July 11th, 2025 we got engaged on a beach at the chapel on the rock in Gaia outside of Porto, Portugal. Here are some snapshots of that day.

```{r}
paths <- c(
  "images/engagement1.JPG",
  "images/engagement2.JPG",
  "images/engagement3.JPG",
  "images/engagement7.jpg",
  "images/engagement5.JPG",
  "images/engagement6.JPG"

)

#library(pixture)
pixture::pixgallery(paths)
```
